message: So, I’ve got a friend who always seems to panic at the thought of fire safety—bless their heart! 🔥 But honestly, it’s a good reminder for all of us to brush up on the basics. I found this helpful resource from the U.S. Fire Administration that breaks down everything from prevention tips to safety measures. It’s a great way to feel a little more prepared and calm in case of any hiccups. What’s your go-to fire safety tip?
